description: This file contains localization settings in Chinese (Traditional) for the jQuery Timepicker Addon, defining translations and configurations for Taiwanese Chinese users.

methods.name: $.timepicker.regional['zh-TW']
methods.description: Defines the regional language settings for Taiwanese Chinese, including labels for UI components and date/time formats.

methods.name: $.timepicker.setDefaults
methods.description: Sets the default regional configuration for the timepicker to use the Taiwanese Chinese settings.
